patch_description: This ansatz replaces 24 independent circuit parameters with three globally shared rotation parameters. Shared rotations impose a strong permutation-aware inductive bias, reducing few-shot overfitting and improving parameter efficiency. A cyclic CZ layer retains nonlocal expressivity and avoids the boundary asymmetry of the original line. Alternating global RY, RZ, and RX layers around the entanglers form a compact Floquet-style block; its three tied repetitions can still generate expressive correlated observables while remaining easier and faster to optimize.
